NOW, THEREFORE,
I, FIDEL V. RAMOS, President of the Republic
of the Philippines,
by virtue of the powers vested in me by law, do hereby
authorize the Philippine Ports Authority
to reclaim and develop submerged
areas vested in the PPA exclusively for port-related purposes.

existing laws.
